adjudication: Each seed evaluated on frozen gates with no deletion. A formal failure with learned capability is a system-level boundary or adverse test of operationalized transport; it is not automatically a logical falsification of all TLIR. If capability fails to form, verdict is NOT_EVALUABLE, not theory failure. Core falsification requires incompatible behavior under the actually asserted scope and all integrity controls.
analysis_after_freeze: Do not change source, selection thresholds, number of seeds, or evaluation logic after formal output; report all pass/fail including negative values.
evidence: Full actual native parameter update post-pre; fixed sample IDs; source/output hashes; 16 real forward coalitions, exact 4-player Shapley, reciprocal same-update different-state response, 6-point finite amplitude path, trained-component initialization rollback

frozen_thresholds.complete_logit_nonadditivity: each checkpoint maximum pairwise full-two-logit RMS interaction >1e-6
frozen_thresholds.distributed_support: mean of 4 snapshot fractions with >=2 active Shapley components (each >=10% total absolute Shapley mass) >=0.50
frozen_thresholds.execution_integrity: frozen model unchanged by repeated inference and outputs byte exact
frozen_thresholds.finite_amplitude: across 4 checkpoints >=10% of 256 target-update path records with max_chord_deviation>0.001 and normalized_deviation>0.1
frozen_thresholds.persistent_reallocation: mean of 4 snapshot fractions with normalized_shapley_L1_reallocation>0.01 >=0.25
frozen_thresholds.receiver: at least 2 of 3 fixed donor/receiver pairs per seed have response_NRMSE >0.05 and max response_RMS >1e-4
frozen_thresholds.rollback: each trained-component replacement by exact pretraining weights changes a full logit >1e-6 and every restore hash/logit is byte exact

model: Four-block residual mean-message-passing GNN; hidden=40; graph readout only at marked anchor node
no_GFG_claim: This is an independent PyTorch experiment with source/result hashes, not a replay of historical GFG or a Core-v3 validated native GFG.
task: Graph-level, 12 nodes, 3 binary node features (anchor, marker, constant); balanced graph instances sampled from ER(0.13...0.37) with random nonanchor permutations; classify whether marker reachable from anchor in <=2 undirected hops; 1024 train,256 held-out test per seed
training: Random init, 500 updates, RMSprop alpha=0.95 eps=1e-8 lr=0.003 momentum=0, batch=64; data and RNG fixed by each formal seed
